summary.prose: Remove the signing-key gate using existing canonical approvals as record authority, while retaining installed runtime isolation validation and stale-evidence checks. Implement the localized gate change with focused regressions, then align operator guidance and run the affected build checks. Activation remains a separate signoff.

tasks.title: Replace signature verification with canonical evidence authority
tasks.summary: Make signature optional deprecated bounded metadata; remove crypto verifier/key IO and verifyProbe seam; preserve approved-reference/digest revalidation on qualification use and existing isolation/file checks. Update focused adoption and qualification regression tests.
acceptanceChecks: Approved unsigned installed-probe records require no key or signature; legacy bounded signatures are inert.
Draft, stale, tampered and raw export records remain refused.
Incomplete isolation evidence, changed runtime pins and stale canonical authority still fail qualification; no engine default flip.

Affected focused tests and build pass; no new live claims or activation state change.
